messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Japanese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Japanese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
高く見上げてその肩を見た すでに惑星の光線に覆われていた 惑星はすべての道で人々をまっすぐ導く。

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Japanese Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------| | guardai | performed the act of looking upward | 見上げて | “looked up” | OK | | in | preposition marking direction | — (no direct word) | — | UNNECESSARY | | alto | “high” (spatial destination) | 高く | “highly / up” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction linking actions | — (conjunction expressed by te‑form) | — | UNNECESSARY | | vidi | performed the act of seeing | 見た | “saw” | OK | | le | definite article (fem. plural) | — (articles omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | sue | possessive adjective indicating ownership | その | “its / that” | OK | | spalle | shoulders (object observed) | 肩 | “shoulder(s)” | OK | | vestite | state of being clothed / covered | 覆われていた | “was clothed / covered” | OK | | già | temporal marker indicating prior completion | すでに | “already” | OK | | de' | preposition + article introducing source of rays | の | “of” | OK | | raggi | rays (light‑like emanations) | 光線 | “rays” | OK | | del | preposition + article introducing planet as origin | の | “of the” | OK | | pianeta | planet (celestial body emitting rays) | 惑星 | “planet” | OK | | che | relative pronoun introducing clause about planet | — (relative clause built implicitly) | — | UNNECESSARY | | mena | planet leads / guides | 導く | “leads / guides” | OK | | dritto | straightly, manner of leading | まっすぐ | “straight / aright” | OK | | altrui | people (recipients of guidance) | 人々 | “people / men” | OK | | per | preposition indicating route | で | “along / by” | OK | | ogne | every (quantifier) | すべての | “every / all” | OK | | calle | path (route) | 道 | “path / road” | OK |

### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `in`, `e`, `le`, `che` – Japanese does not require separate words for these grammatical functions; their meanings are conveyed by morphology or omitted. No missing content.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Japanese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Japanese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
